name: Event Sourcing
forces_resolved: 100% complete, immutable audit log of every state change that ever occurred
Ability to reconstruct state at any historical point in time (temporal queries)
Avoids object-relational impedance mismatch by persisting append-only events
forces_unresolved: Steep learning curve and unfamiliar programming paradigm
Event schema evolution and migration over years of version changes
Querying current state requires replaying events or maintaining projections (CQRS dependency)
applicability_conditions: Financial ledgers, regulatory compliance systems, audit-intensive banking domains
Collaborative editing, version control systems, and insurance claims adjudications
Domains where why and how a state changed is as critical as the current state
anti_requisites: Simple CRUD entities with destructive overwrite semantics
GDPR right-to-be-forgotten hard requirements without cryptographic shredding design
Team unfamiliar with event versioning and upcasting patterns
